Title: RSI Disc. Month: Procure Refined Iron
Description:
CONTRACT: Purchase Order
LOCATION: N/A

TERMS*:
With the recent unveiling of their new ships, RSI wishes to increase their production capacity but ran into problems thanks to a recent empire-wide supply-chain issue. As such, they have contracted with Shubin Interstellar to fulfill a purchase order for <EM4>refined iron</EM4>.

Using a self-provided <EM4>mining ship</EM4>, harvest the iron and <EM4>process it a refinery center</EM4> of your choice before delivering it to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4>. Please note, any materials delivered in excess will not be returned.

For advice on where to find the required materials, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview</EM4> if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and relieve Shubin Interstellar of accountability for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
